REBOUNDOPS / LOCAL DEVELOPER PREVIEW

Job-search workspace

Use the dashboard, opportunity filters and application tracker with clear data boundaries.

On this pageStart from the search workbenchDiscover and narrow opportunitiesKeep applications in viewSet up sources and inspect resultsReview and share deliberatelyPrepare and review material

Start from the search workbench

Start with one role you’re considering. Review the posting, record an application in Applications, then set up sources when you’re ready to find more roles. The search workbench shows your next recovery action and active applications.

Discover and narrow opportunities

Open Scan (#/scan) to use configured public sources. Filter the returned list by role and available facets, then inspect the underlying posting. Source availability, rate limits and configuration affect coverage. An adapter is not a partnership or a complete index of jobs.

Use Pipeline (#/pipeline) to organize job URLs awaiting review. Job evaluation and company research have their own setup; configured AI tools may send data externally and incur charges.

Keep applications in view

Open Applications (#/tracker). Search by company or role, filter statuses and switch between the table and Kanban views. Use the outcome action to review an application event and add relevant notes. Review the preview before confirming any change.

Statuses describe your records. A job score is an advisory signal, not a hiring probability. Keep follow-up notes factual and check the original posting before acting.

Set up sources and inspect results

Open Portals to discover a company’s public board and add it explicitly. If you already know its supported Greenhouse, Ashby or Lever HTTPS board URL, use Add known board URL; availability is checked by a subsequent scan or health check.

Scan reviews the actual role query, optional comma-separated location limit and selected sources. Regional sources require opt-in. The selected query can clear older display filters, and Show this scan’s results reapplies it. Fetched, matched and displayed counts are separate. A completed zero-match result offers query/location review and additional employer boards; one board is not the whole job market. Failed and partial scans are identified; retained results may be older. Work model is Unknown unless the source provides evidence; geographic eligibility remains separate.

Review and share deliberately

In Evaluate, choose Prepare an editable prompt — no provider call. Review the included sources and remove identifiers or confidential sections before sharing. Editing clears sharing approval; Copy is available only after you approve the current draft. Download prompt privately saves the edited text locally.

Bring a web-chat answer back accepts pasted text or a UTF-8 text/Markdown file. Name it, inspect the answer and confirm before saving a local report. Editing or importing an answer clears its review confirmation. No CV, evidence or score is applied automatically. Recording an application is a separate action.

Prepare and review material

CV and CV Studio help maintain application material; Reports holds saved job reviews. Interview and networking tools depend on their configuration. Review all generated text against your real experience before using it.

Workspace CVs, reports and applications are local files, separate from recovery sessions. Opening a workspace page does not synchronize evidence or targets. Reviewed handoffs omit already-present CV achievements. A raw recovery JSON backup does not back up workspace records; choose the combined career backup for eligible workspace files.
